notes: Both waws take the connectives the ASV wrote (*then*, *Or*) under rule 14; both stative imperfects head on their adjectival complements (rule 44).

יְלוּד אִשָּׁה is the written subject of the second clause: the supplied *he that is* joins the anarthrous participle under rule 46, discontinuous under rule 25, and the rectum takes *of a woman* under rules 19 and 15. Margin *Or, before* read and set aside (rule 38).
